scope: Experimental >32K context and coding-round optimisation, not production deployment
strategy: Preserve existing compact-SWA ring padding during explicit sequence save. Keep original restore/reuse guard. Match stream geometry. Retain compact CPU KV for warm coding and large contexts.
isolated_patch: Environment-gated LLAMA_EXPERIMENTAL_SWA_SAVE_PADDING; only standard-SWA explicit seq saves, not partial checkpoint saves. No repo-source or installed-library edit.
gates: Fresh speech-side clearance plus immediate and continuous native/jobs/socket checks
Approved maintenance stop and automatic original-service restore
>=6GiB MemAvailable, <=16MiB swap per experimental process; temperature annotation only
First4K compact same-backend save/restore with and without padding, target state finite and expected token coverage
Then compact GPU->CPU4K: same-type/layout, target/MTP recall and cached append; no exact cross-backend output equality gate
Only after4K gates,64K input with compact contexts. Startup/page-in separate; single-stream trial not claimed as two128K service
Independent beginning/middle/end long recall and followup correctness; inspect serialized state finite
Coding warm rounds: fixed teacher-forced history for cache/MTP/timing control plus real median edit/test loops; repeated counterbalanced candidate/baseline comparisons
Retain original prompt/token/tool-output schema; minimise fixture changes and preserve independently failing tests
No deploy, commit or push without further approval

budget.other_memory: Weights, MTP/repacking, backend/driver staging, workspaces, transfers and services are additional; sampled host reserve mandatory. Avoid dual full-SWA64K allocation.
budget.long_context_first_step: single stream per backend65,536 or larger capacity, >=60K actual prompt; document capacity vs actual length

warm_diagnosis: Saved warm runs have531 evaluated/573 generated tokens on each path. Aggregate hybrid overhead~7.80s, of which6.14s decode and1.42s prompt. Build/full-SWA/GPU-residency confounded. Do not presume a router-cache miss caused it.

acceptance.task_quality: Independent correctness and source-grounded output; drift alone diagnostic
acceptance.warm_latency: Aim <=baseline warm median; do not claim benefit unless matched repeated evidence supports it
acceptance.long_context: Context beyond32K with finite transferable state and correct recall/append
